summary: Describes how RSVP-TE traffic engineering can be supported in BGP/MPLS Layer 3 VPNs, where a provider edge node serves multiple customers in different VPNs. It is an experimental specification.

eli5.summary: Many businesses share one big network, each with a private lane. This explains how to reserve special fast lanes for one business without mixing it up with others.
